statement: 9 of the 10 OVERRULES/QUESTIONS proposals are not the deciding court's own words; only Parashotam -> Shri Kant Sharma (TC-222df5c885ad) is supported. Both Puttaswamy (2018) OVERRULES proposals named in the README are Shayara Bano wording (one inside a quotation, one introduced by "in the view of Justice Nariman"). The README rule that quoted passages, submissions and reports of another bench "never produce a proposal" does not hold on this build.
evidence: TC-128e107ecf9e, TC-71d95f475fc0 (counsel: "Mr Sai Deepak ... has contended"); TC-09679a2ecb19, TC-90c9e02ff612, TC-c384ec7817d6 (inside quotations); TC-9dbb3103f31 (referring Bench's view); TC-2519aca12fd7 ("It is the stand of few of the petitioners"); TC-3e95aa6d4f3b ("According to him"); TC-23134ce50bfb (report of Shayara Bano). Four of the nine also name the wrong authority.
requested_action: Fix attribution before this tier goes to the adviser: detect quotation spans across page breaks and SCC-bracket style, submission lead-ins ("contended", "stand of", "According to him", "in the view of"), and require the cue's grammatical object to be the stated target. Withdraw the nine proposals; correct the README sentence about the Puttaswamy proposals.

statement: All 17 APPLIES proposals targeting Narsingh Yadav say the opposite of the text. The Punjab & Haryana boilerplate reads "such onus has not been discharged by the employer ... to show that the respondent's case is covered by Narsingh Yadav's case": the court holds the case not covered. negated=NO on every row.
evidence: TC-3d30cdc267cc, TC-49ab07eb791d, TC-2e28c1f03791 in the sample; population count 17 of 17 (context check on each row).
requested_action: Extend negation scope to the governing clause ("has not been discharged ... to show that ... is covered by"); withdraw the 17 proposals or re-type them after a documentary read.

statement: Footnote adjacency links a cue to the wrong authority. 11 of the 20 citation-string APPLIES proposals targeting Dharamvir come from "The issue is covered by ... Gawas Anil Madso", where Dharamvir is only the preceding footnote. The eight Delhi HC 05-08-2025 rows that put Dharamvir at adviser review for "doubted" rest on a generic sentence about J&K National Conference.
evidence: TC-24ff52b0997c; TC-ce29896ee6cb (also printed in the dossier's Dharamvir table); TC-1f180392f404 and seven siblings.
requested_action: When a footnote block lists several citations, bind the cue to the footnote marker attached to the cue's own sentence. Remove the eight "doubted" rows from the adviser queue.

statement: REPORTED_TREATMENT_OF_TARGET rows at adviser review are about the stated target in 13 of 47 cases (28%). In 13 the stated target is the case doing the overruling, not the one overruled.
evidence: Direction inverted: TC-5a542c52e713 (Harjeet Singh Sandhu), TC-2f1045ea3f8f (R.R. Pillai), TC-fb28664670ff (Tulsiram Patel), TC-d5348a518013 (Ajmer Singh), TC-e2f22c47da13 (Maneka Gandhi), TC-f43ad21d7d99 (L. Chandra Kumar) and seven more. Not a treatment at all: TC-a29676a7a5c4 (a plea "was overruled"), TC-354fc6be39a8 (inversion test).
requested_action: Add an agent/patient check ("overruled BY/IN X" vs "X overruled Y"); emit the row against the patient, or drop it. As delivered, this queue would cost an adviser 34 dead reads in 47.

statement: A court's own present-voice overruling was classed as a report of another court and got no proposal. Puttaswamy (2017), Chandrachud J.: "ADM Jabalpur must be and is accordingly overruled. We also overrule the decision in Union of India v Bhanudas Krishna Gawde".
evidence: TC-3b178e403337, p.167, attribution REPORTED_TREATMENT_OF_TARGET, reason "sentence reports what another court/bench held".
requested_action: Treat "is (accordingly|hereby) overruled" and "We (also) overrule" as first-person cues. Re-scan the 345 OVERRULES cue hits for the same pattern.

statement: DISTINGUISHES proposals: 5 of 15 sampled are supported. Failures are headnote text zoned as BODY, counsel submissions, reports of another court's holding, and phrases that are not treatment at all.
evidence: Headnote: TC-aa3c085f11b3, TC-6f734c469079 (S.P. Gupta pp.21 and 91, "held inapplicable"). Submission: TC-ec8ed8b6c9f6. Not treatment: TC-5004f163aed9 ("distinguishing data"), TC-62dee0bd93fe, TC-05bda1173a69.
requested_action: Extend the editorial zone to the true end of long SCR headnotes (it runs past p.100 in S.P. Gupta); require the cue's subject to be the cited decision.

statement: Name-reference anchors use bigrams that are generic or belong to another case. All five "Navtej Singh" references are to Navtej Singh Johar but resolve to Sqn Ldr (Retd.) Navtej Singh v. UOI; "Mills Ltd" resolves Prithvi Cotton Mills to Minerva Mills; "MADRAS BAR" is the citing judgment's own running header.
evidence: TC-cf76841ef075 (proposed DISTINGUISHES), TC-17a1908fe5b0, TC-1ae4124ee64f, TC-20b4a6030212. Other weak bigrams in use: "human rights", "JUSTICE K", "Ram Narain", "Balbir Singh".
requested_action: Drop bigrams that are corporate suffixes, common name pairs or running-header text; reject a match when the next token contradicts the target ("Johar").

statement: At least 717 of the 24,000 edges are not citations: they are the citing judgment's own SCR running header plus a paragraph or page number ("SUPREME COURT REPORTS [2018] 11 S.C.R." + "28."). Two of them are RESOLVED to unrelated judgments at AUTOMATED_DETECTED, the status the README reserves for the most reliable method.
evidence: E-991b18f7e2d5 (Joseph Shine -> Maj Amod Kumar), E-2c2a39c3ee49 (Nanukuttan Nair -> another 2019 judgment). Count: edges whose SCR key has the citing judgment's own year and volume = 717 (703 UNRESOLVED, 8 CITATION_MISMATCH, 4 AMBIGUOUS, 2 RESOLVED). TC-ac61ab8c65ff is a DISTINGUISHES proposal built on one.
requested_action: Strip running headers before citation detection, or drop SCR keys that share year and volume with the citing judgment's own reported citation. Re-state edge totals and the resolution rate afterwards.

statement: PARTY_YEAR_COURT mislinks Indian Express Newspapers (Bombay) v. UOI, (1985) 1 SCC 641, to Express Newspapers Pvt. Ltd. v. UOI (Oct/Nov 1985, [1985] Supp. 3 SCR 382). Nine edges. Three print "[1985] 2 SCR 287", which contradicts the target's own SCR citation, so the citation-mismatch guard did not fire.
evidence: E-1dcba84c3b7e in the sample; nine edges target sc-1985-express-newspapers-pvt-ltd-ors-1985insc238.
requested_action: Apply the mismatch guard to every reporter key in the cluster, including "Supp." SCR volumes; unresolve the nine edges.

statement: Cue-based statute relationships are supported in 9 of 30 sampled rows. PROVISION_CHALLENGED is the worst: 227 of its 284 rows are Constitution articles, and in the sample those articles are the ground of challenge, not the provision challenged. PROVISION_APPLIED mostly records a party invoking Article 226 or an FIR narration ("invoking", "invoked", "punishable under" are 179 of 303 cues). Three sampled rows state the opposite of the text.
evidence: Ground not target: SL-c76e283e0af6, SL-7174a4c37149, SL-c93364807a16. Opposite: SL-4153dc9e6b28 (Art. 311 "not available"), SL-44d0735270ad, SL-e89b991dea34. By label: APPLIED 0/6, INTERPRETED 1/6, CHALLENGED 1/6, QUOTED 5/6, HELD_INAPPLICABLE 2/6.
requested_action: Rename or split the labels (GROUND_OF_CHALLENGE, INVOKED_BY_PARTY, CHARGED_UNDER); bind the cue to the provision as grammatical subject or object; keep only PROVISION_QUOTED as cue-reliable until then.

statement: No provision version is asserted (all 11,067 rows VERSION_NOT_ESTABLISHED), but the instrument itself is wrong in six rows: a 1972 Supreme Court judgment whose text prints "Code of Criminal Procedure 1898" is linked to CRPC-1973.
requested_action: Add CRPC-1898; never assign CRPC-1973 to a judgment dated before 1 April 1974 or where the text prints 1898. Check the same for the 1911 Army Act and pre-1973 Evidence/Penal Code mentions.

statement: The same Army Rule gets two ids depending on how the judgment words it ("Section 180 of the Army Rules" -> AR-1954:s.180; elsewhere AR-1954:r.180). 9 AR-1954 rows use "s." and 5 AA-1950 rows use "r.".
requested_action: Normalise the unit by instrument (rules -> r., Acts -> s.) and keep the printed form in a separate column.
